data.one_liner: A collection of lints and code assists for Jaspr projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides custom lints and code assists tailored for Jaspr web and server-side projects. It checks for preferred HTML components, proper styles ordering, and unsafe platform-specific imports.
use_when: You are developing a project using the Jaspr web framework
You want automated checks and fixes for Jaspr code style and best practices
avoid_when: You are not using the Jaspr framework
strengths: Provides helpful code fixes and assists for IDEs
Helps catch unsafe platform-specific imports in Jaspr components
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Jaspr framework ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add jaspr_lints as a plugin to your analysis_options.yaml file and run dart pub get.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard official Dart lint rules if you do not need Jaspr-specific rules.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official lint rules for Flutter projects.

data.minimal_example:
plugins:
  jaspr_lints:
    version: ^0.6.0
    diagnostics:
      sort_children_last: true
      prefer_html_components: true
      styles_ordering: true
